summary: API and JSON CLI packets are identical, stdio MCP matches the API, and state, events, and specs remain byte-for-byte unchanged by Explore.

Committed context and design guidance appear in packets, while conflicting guidance still cannot bypass the required design artifact.
Repeatable generated integrations expose Explore, automatic Fast/Complex selection, explicit packet workstreams, and post-Review Archive without profile or JSON UX.
Existing Fast, Complex, Quick, revision, repair, browser, screenshot, evidence, review, integration, and concurrency tests all pass with enforced Complex Archive.
